description: stoa-mail has 4 Prometheus metrics but no OpenTelemetry SDK. No OTLP trace/span export, no centralized log export, no tracing-opentelemetry bridge. Mechanical fix: copy telemetry.rs pattern from transit/reader, add 5 OTel deps (same versions: 0.31/0.32), call init_telemetry() in main.rs, wire tracing_opentelemetry::layer(). Existing Prometheus metrics coexist cleanly. Files: crates/mail/Cargo.toml, crates/mail/src/main.rs, new crates/mail/src/telemetry.rs.
title: Add full OTel to stoa-mail (traces, metrics, logs export)
